title: Norlan loading bay | Report on the morning lift trial
titleZh: 諾蘭裝卸區｜上午升降試驗報告
passage:
I filed this report after the morning lift trial at Norlan loading bay because we had to change motion loggers partway through. A logger’s serial number identifies the machine; a session code is what we search to retrieve the movements. We can set a spare to the code already in use. If it goes live under its factory code instead, keep the recordings separate and list both codes on the request; do not rename the first recording. There was also a rattle that made the crew wonder whether the load was loose. I want to separate that sound from the logger issue.

At 10:00, logger K18 started recording the trial under AX. Our spare, K44, passed its bench check at 10:12. I took it to the bay and saw the signal switch to it at 10:19. When the lift restarted, K44’s display showed Q0. The bench check tells us when the spare was ready, not when it took over. I recorded 10:19 as the handover because I saw the signal switch.

The final lift movement of the trial ended at 10:43. Afterward, I used K44 for an unrelated calibration and left its code unchanged. At 10:46 I logged the first movement of that calibration, “Raise 5 cm.” Calibration and bench checks do not belong in the trial record, even if they share a code with work that does. Please send the record of the whole trial, not everything either logger captured.

Before we moved the lift, a porter pushed the same empty trolley across the entrance. I heard the rattle while the platform stood still, just as he went over the raised metal threshold. There is a removable tray under the trolley handle. It can rattle against the trolley frame when the wheels strike a raised edge; it was in place in both runs. The yard route avoids the raised edge altogether.

The crew leader wants one repeat with the lift carrying the same load and with the trolley trip still part of the work. The bay fitter says the plate can be held tight against its supports from below. That would stop the plate moving but leave its top surface at the same height. We normally fit a flat ramp over the threshold when we need to move fragile crates; it keeps the wheels from striking the raised edge.
passageZh:
諾蘭裝卸區的上午升降試驗進行到一半時，我們必須更換動作記錄器，所以我在試驗後寫了這份報告。記錄器的序號用來辨認設備；要調閱動作紀錄，則用場次代碼搜尋。我們可以把備機設為正在使用的代碼。若備機上線時仍使用出廠代碼，請保留兩段分開的紀錄，並在申請單上列出兩個代碼；不要把第一段紀錄改名。 當時還有一陣喀啦聲，讓工作人員懷疑貨物是否鬆動。我想把這個聲音和記錄器的問題分開查。

10:00，記錄器 K18 開始以 AX 代碼錄下試驗。備機 K44 在 10:12 通過工作檯測試。我把備機帶到裝卸區，親眼看到訊號在 10:19 切換到這台備機。升降設備重新運轉時，K44 的顯示器顯示 Q0。工作檯測試只說明備機何時準備就緒，不代表它何時正式接手。我看到訊號切換，所以把 10:19 記為交接時間。

試驗最後一個升降動作在 10:43 結束。之後我用 K44 做了另一項不相關的校正，沿用原代碼。10:46，我記下那項校正的第一個動作：「升高 5 公分」。即使用的是同一個代碼，校正與工作檯測試仍不屬於試驗紀錄。請提供整次試驗的紀錄，而不是兩部記錄器錄下的所有內容。

升降台還沒動之前，一名搬運員推著同一輛空手推車過入口。升降台當時靜止；他剛推過凸起的金屬門檻，我就聽到同樣的喀啦聲。手推車把手下有個可拆式托盤。輪子碰到凸起的邊緣時，托盤可能敲到車架發出喀啦聲；兩次操作時托盤都在原位。改走院子就完全不會碰到凸起的邊緣。

組長希望再做一次試驗，升降台仍裝同樣的貨物，也照常用手推車搬運。裝卸區的維修人員說，可以從下方把金屬板壓緊在支座上，板子就不會晃動，但上表面高度不變。平常要搬易碎箱子時，我們會在門檻上架一塊平順的坡板，避免輪子撞到凸起的邊緣。
